status: verified and staged; not flashed; hardware result unknown
scope: flashable V01K package for one muted 2K attach test
change_summary: Firmware-only: the native USB-MIDI preflight now runs again after interrupts are masked and refuses instead of entering the sender. The Pi build is unchanged.

pi.note: This candidate changes only device firmware, so the currently installed matching Pi kernel stays paired. Re-verify the kernel hash before the trial rather than re-flashing the SD card.

pre_flash_checks: Candidate and every recovery file re-hashed from the package (done).
Protected sections 2, 4, 5 and 8 unchanged from stock (done).

setup: Disposable project; note the exact pattern and LFO settings
steps: Record the pre-flash baseline: FIFO underrun count, playout faults, USB gaps/errors, Pi uptime and kernel hash.
Install Digitakt-V01K-diagnostic.syx with Transfer. Human flash only; do not touch the bootloader or wiring.
Confirm the reported version reads V01K.
Set SPD back down before reconnecting. Select USB1 on track 1, confirm the panel responds.
Raise the TRX-B2 PTCH LFO to maximum speed with depth 5-10. This is the formerly failing workload.
Watch the panel for 30 s. Stop at the first sign of unresponsiveness.
If frozen: pull the cable, wait 30 s, note whether the UI recovers, then power-cycle.
Record the same counters afterwards, plus FIFO/underruns and any new fault.

outcome_meaning.responsive_30s: The masked-preflight race was the cause, or the guard avoided it. Still needs repeat runs and Gates B/C.
outcome_meaning.frozen_on_attach: The guard did not remove the trigger. Next suspect is the RX/ACK interrupt path; do not flash again before that analysis.
outcome_meaning.frozen_after_delay: Send-path volume still matters: collect counters before power-cycling, they are evidence.

stop_conditions: Any new Pi fault or FIFO underrun growth
Audio stop while muted is expected; audio stop when unmuted is not

rollback: Install Digitakt-I04R-previous.syx (the accepted prototype), or Digitakt-OS1.54-stock-recovery.syx for stock. Both are in the package and hash-verified.
limits: Emulator cannot reproduce the physical hang, so the causal link remains a hypothesis.
The candidate keeps the V01 diagnostic settings (remote telemetry, compact snapshots, no self-wake), so it is a test image.
